amendment_reason: The V1-default regression check counted the NEW additive file fusion/alert_policy_v2_binding.py as a modified V1 file because its git pathspec covers the fusion/ directory. The pathspec filter was scoped to --diff-filter=MDRT (modified/deleted/renamed/type-changed). No pass criterion for any V1 file was loosened, and no model, calibration, policy, signal-processing or replay behavior changed.
